name: Fiat-Crypto (Coq) plus AWS s2n-tls and aws-lc SAW proofs
subject: elliptic-curve field arithmetic; HMAC, DRBG, TLS 1.2/1.3 handshake state machine (s2n-tls); SHA-2, HMAC, AES-KW(P), AES-GCM (aws-lc)
tool: Coq/Rocq >= 9.0 (Fiat-Crypto); SAW 0.9.0.99 + Cryptol + Z3 (s2n-tls); SAW, NSym, Coq, Clang 10/14 (aws-lc)
org: MIT CSAIL; Amazon Web Services and Galois
impl_language: C (generated by Fiat; existing C in s2n-tls/aws-lc), x86_64/AArch64 assembly

tcb.unverified_translator: Fiat pretty-printer and C compiler; Clang (LLVM bitcode) and SAW symbolic execution; ToolGap between SAW and NSym
tcb.note: axiom/admit = fiat-crypto (Admitted 8 + admit 9; most Axiom inside module types); unsafe_assume_spec = s2n-tls 20 + aws-lc 130; SAW proofs bounded (input lengths, trace length 16)

loc.note: spec = s2n Cryptol lines; proof = s2n .saw 1525 + aws-lc .saw 15181; impl = s2n 'less than 10k LOC' (CAV 2018); Fiat Coq src 183,411 lines

pattern: (a) generic verified algorithm + certified specialising compiler to C; (b) bounded symbolic execution of existing C/LLVM/x86 against executable Cryptol spec in CI [impl_link: SAW symbolic execution of LLVM bitcode/x86 = binary-semantics; Fiat part = extraction]
